mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID AS memberId, DIABETES_TYPE AS diabetesType, DIAGNOSE_AT AS diagnoseAt, HBA1C_VALUE AS hba1cValue, HBA1C_DATE AS hba1cDate, HAS_COMPLICATION AS hasComplication, WEIGHT AS weight, MEDICATION_INFO AS medicationInfo, FAMILY_HISTORY_YN AS familyHistoryYn, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM DIABETES_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO DIABETES_PROFILE t USING (SELECT #{memberId} AS MEMBER_ID FROM dual) s ON (t.MEMBER_ID = s.MEMBER_ID)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DIABETES_TYPE = #{diabetesType}, DIAGNOSE_AT = #{diagnoseAt}, HBA1C_VALUE = #{hba1cValue}, HBA1C_DATE = #{hba1cDate}, HAS_COMPLICATION = #{hasComplication}, WEIGHT = #{weight}, MEDICATION_INFO = #{medicationInfo}, FAMILY_HISTORY_YN = #{familyHistoryYn}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( MEMBER_ID, DIABETES_TYPE, DIAGNOSE_AT, HBA1C_VALUE, HBA1C_DATE, HAS_COMPLICATION, WEIGHT, MEDICATION_INFO, FAMILY_HISTORY_YN, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{diabetesType}, #{diagnoseAt}, #{hba1cValue}, #{hba1cDate}, #{hasComplication}, #{weight}, #{medicationInfo}, #{familyHistoryYn}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
